project_overview.summary: The project is a Spring Boot application that manages various entities such as actors, films, customers, payments, rentals, and staff within a movie rental system. It includes modules for authentication, authorization, and data management with RESTful APIs.
key_modules: SpringRestSakilaApplication.java - Entry point of the application
Security-related components (JwtAuthenticationFilter, JwtTokenProvider) - JWT-based authentication and security
PersistenceConfig.java - Configures JPA and Querydsl for database interactions

ActorController, FilmController, CustomerController, LocationController, PaymentController, RentalController, StaffController, ReportController - REST controllers handling CRUD operations and business logic
CustomRepository implementations (e.g., CustomFilmRepositoryImpl) - Utilizes QueryDSL for dynamic query construction
recurring_patterns: DTOs with Lombok annotations - Simplifies data transfer objects
Caching mechanisms - @Cacheable, @CachePut, and @CacheEvict annotations for efficient data retrieval
Validation constraints using Hibernate/JPA annotations - Ensures data integrity at the entity level
Spring Security integration - Handles authentication, authorization, and session management
project_overview.complexity_assessment: The project has a moderate complexity due to its size and the number of modules involved. The use of Spring Boot, Querydsl, and Lombok simplifies development but requires careful handling of dependencies and configurations.
